request.question: How did orders per day on Saturdays change from 2193-Q3 to 2193-Q4?

reply: I compared orders per day on Saturdays, from 2193-Q3 to 2193-Q4. Saturday orders per day fell by 64.46, a fall of 26% The Q3 figure was 247.69 and the Q4 figure was 183.23.
